summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting the September 29, 2026 close of an exercise window for outstanding warrants over its DKK 1 ordinary shares. Exercises during the window produced aggregate share capital increases of nominal DKK 210,812, taking registered share capital to DKK 66,400,738 via issuance of 210,812 ordinary shares at average cash consideration of about USD 123.36 per share, using the September 29 DKK-USD rate. Articles of association were amended and filed as Exhibit 1.1; no advisor, board recommendation, or special-situation transaction was disclosed. Watch only dilution and warrant overhang mechanics, not deal arbitrage.
